audit.whatIsWrong: The chart read Skill/Skill/Skill/Aurora/Skill/Aurora/Aurora in both layers, disagreeing with the already-audited mirror (aurora__sett), which set Aurora / Skill / Sett / Sett / Aurora / Sett / Skill.
audit.why: The mirror is the audited side and the prose on both pages argues for that shape: Aurora edges Level 1 on Twofold Hex range, Sett takes 3 through 5 once Facebreaker exists, Aurora takes 6 on the Between Worlds rift, and two items evens out.
audit.corrected: Both layers set to Aurora / Skill / Sett / Sett / Aurora / Sett / Skill as one atomic paired group with ratings matched. whys[4] and phases[4].why rewritten so Level 6 reads as Aurora's, which is what the rift teleport actually does.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Twofold Hex (Blink)' is a conflation of two different abilities and it was the tracked cooldown in the TL;DR, win condition, loading screen, focus panel, cooldown panel, three phases, both do's and five report sections.
audit.why: Twofold Hex is her Q — a 900-range curse missile she recasts to drag back through you, up every 9/8.5/8/7.5/7s. The leap is Across the Veil (W), 22/21/20/19/18s, and that is the cooldown the whole matchup is played around. Between Worlds is 140/120/100s.
audit.corrected: Every instance retargeted to Across the Veil at 22s as the tracked escape, with Twofold Hex restated as the 9s poke and the recast drag-back the player has to sidestep.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page told the player twice to hold a 120-second ultimate to 'suppress her through the W blink'. It also never mentioned that Spirit Abjuration heals her off everything she lands.
audit.why: Riot's text for The Show Stopper is carry, slam, damage and a landing slow — no suppression, and nothing that follows a blink. The mirror audit stripped the same fabrication from five strings on Aurora's page. Meanwhile her passive heals her from exorcised spirits, which is what actually decides a poke war.
audit.corrected: Suppression removed from spikes[1] and wants.you[2] and replaced with 'use it before she leaps, not after'; the passive heal stated in dontsFull[0].d as the reason not to poke-war her.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[2] was titled 'Build MR' with a body about wasting a blink, and the item line said 'vs his poke' against a female champion.
audit.why: Aurora's damage is entirely magic, so Mercury's Treads into Spirit Visage is the actual advice the heading promises.
audit.corrected: dosFull[2].d now names the MR items; report[8].t pronoun fixed and tied to Twofold Hex poke.

edits.before: She kites and blinks — build MR, E-stun when her dash is down. Sett wins by trading around Aurora's Twofold Hex (Blink) and cashing the pattern: build MR and all-in off her blink.
edits.after: She kites and blinks — build MR and Facebreaker her once Across the Veil is spent. Sett wins by trading around that 22s leap and the Spirit Abjuration heal her poke feeds her.

edits.before: Build MR and all-in off her blink. Track Twofold Hex (Blink) before every commit and keep the wave on your side.
edits.after: Build MR and all-in once Across the Veil is spent. That leap is 22s at rank 1 — count it before every commit.

edits.before: Aurora wins by landing Twofold Hex (Blink), denying your pattern, and out-trading your engage windows.
edits.after: Aurora wins by poking with Twofold Hex, leaping clear on Across the Veil, and healing it back on her passive.

edits.before: - Sett vs Aurora - Track: Aurora Twofold Hex (Blink). - Keep the wave on your side. - Engage only on Twofold Hex (Blink)'s cooldown. - Don't trade with an empty grit bar. - Ultimate = kill windows only.
edits.after: - Sett vs Aurora - Track: Aurora Across the Veil, 22s. - Keep the wave on your side. - Engage only once that leap is spent. - Don't trade with an empty grit bar. - Ultimate = kill windows only.

edits.before: Lead banked — now convert. Shove, take plates, recall on your Stridebreaker timing, then freeze and zone Aurora off the comeback farm. Dive with your jungler when Twofold Hex (Blink) is down.
edits.after: Lead banked — now convert. Shove, take plates, recall on your Stridebreaker timing, then freeze and zone Aurora off the comeback farm. Dive with your jungler once Across the Veil is spent.

edits.before: Q gives move speed toward Aurora and two empowered punches. Take short Q trades and back off before she can answer with Twofold Hex (Blink).
edits.after: Knuckle Down's move speed closes on her and lands two empowered punches. Trade short and step out before Twofold Hex's return hit clips you.

edits.before: Facebreaker is online — the E-stun into double punch + W is your full pattern. Run it the moment Aurora burns Twofold Hex (Blink).
edits.after: Facebreaker is online at 16s and she is a squishy mage in melee range. Run the full pattern the moment Across the Veil is spent.

edits.before: The Show Stopper online — you can start fights Aurora doesn't want. Suplex her into your wave or tower, never into her own minions.
edits.after: Between Worlds leaves a rift she teleports across, so she walks out of the all-in you thought you had won. Use The Show Stopper first.

edits.before: Sterak's makes your all-in nearly unburstable. Fights are decided by whether you cash a max-grit W — track Twofold Hex (Blink) and commit on the gap.
edits.after: Sterak's makes your all-in nearly unburstable, and Haymaker's centre is true damage her MR cannot touch. Commit once Across the Veil is spent.

edits.before: Trade strictly around Twofold Hex (Blink): when it is down, run your full pattern; when it is up, give nothing. If ahead, freeze and starve her.
edits.after: Trade strictly around Across the Veil: when that 22s leap is spent, run your full pattern; when it is up, give nothing. Freeze if you are ahead.

edits.before: - Aurora Twofold Hex (Blink): matchup-defining — Her escape. E-stun her when down. Track it before every engage. - Aurora Across the Veil: Blinks a short distance into the spirit realm — her escape/reposition. Dodge or sidestep it.
edits.after: - Aurora Across the Veil: matchup-defining — her leap into invisibility, 22s at rank 1. Step up the moment it is spent. - Aurora Twofold Hex: a 900-range curse she recasts to drag back through you, up every 9s. Sidestep the return.

edits.before: If Aurora gets a kill, stop forcing and respect Twofold Hex (Blink). Two kills: farm safe and call for jungle cover. If she snowballs, play for picks with your team — not solo redemption.
edits.after: If Aurora gets a kill, stop forcing and respect Across the Veil. Two kills: farm safe and call for jungle cover. If she snowballs, play for picks with your team — not solo redemption.

edits.before: Overall difficulty: 7/10. The lane is decided by how well you track Twofold Hex (Blink) and how disciplined your pattern is.
edits.after: Overall difficulty: 7/10. The lane is decided by how well you count Across the Veil and how disciplined your pattern is.

edits.after: Track Aurora's Across the Veil before you commit

edits.before: Her escape. E-stun her when down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Her leap into invisibility, 22s at rank 1. Step up once it is spent.

edits.before: Aurora wastes Twofold Hex (Blink) — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Mercury's Treads then Spirit Visage — her whole kit is magic damage.

edits.before: That is Aurora's favourite window — refuse it and half her win condition is gone.
edits.after: Spirit Abjuration heals her off every spell she lands — a poke war feeds her.

edits.before: Build MR and all-in off her blink. Track Twofold Hex (Blink) before every commit.
edits.after: Build MR and all-in once Across the Veil is spent — that leap is 22s at rank 1.

edits.before: Track Aurora's Twofold Hex (Blink): Her escape. E-stun her when down. When it is down — E-stun + W her.
edits.after: Track Across the Veil: her leap into invisibility, 22s at rank 1. Once spent — Facebreaker, punch, Haymaker.

edits.before: Commit on Twofold Hex (Blink)'s cooldown, on your level-6 spike, and on your Stridebreaker timing. Bait her answer first.
edits.after: Commit once Across the Veil is spent, on your level-6 spike, and on your Stridebreaker timing. Bait that leap out first.

edits.before: Start Doran's Shield + Health Potion  (vs his poke). Core: Stridebreaker  (stick to them through the W panel window), then Sterak's Gage; boots Mercury's Treads. First back: Phage / Tiamat + boots (≈1300g).
edits.after: Start Doran's Shield + Health Potion (vs her Twofold Hex poke). Core: Stridebreaker (stick to her through the Haymaker window), then Sterak's Gage; boots Mercury's Treads. First back: Phage + boots (≈1300g).

edits.before: At 6 you keep the edge by suppressing her through the blink with R.
edits.after: At 6 the Between Worlds rift lets her teleport out of your all-in.

edits.before: Aurora's Q bounce and W Twofold Hex blink let her poke and reposition, but she's a squishy mage in melee range. Once you have Q slow and E Facebreaker, close the gap through her minions, E-stun, and W Haymaker chunks half her bar. Bank Grit so P heals the poke back.
edits.after: Aurora's Twofold Hex poke and Across the Veil leap let her reposition, but she's a squishy mage in melee range. Once you have Q slow and E Facebreaker, close through her minions, E-stun, and Haymaker chunks half her bar. Bank Grit so P heals the poke back.

edits.before: Her R Between Worlds zones and can trap you, but it doesn't save her from a committed all-in. Use R The Show Stopper to suppress her through the W blink -- otherwise she'll flicker out of your combo. Fight when her W is on cooldown.
edits.after: Her R Between Worlds slows and leaves a rift she can teleport across, so she leaves an all-in you thought you had won -- and it's 140s at rank 1. Use The Show Stopper before she leaps, not after, and fight when Across the Veil is down.

edits.before: With a first mage item Aurora's burst ramps and her W blink dodges your engage. Don't dump your combo when W is up; walk her to a wall, wait out the blink, then E-stun and drop a full-Grit W before she flickers.
edits.after: With a first mage item her burst ramps and Across the Veil dodges your engage. Don't dump your combo while that 22s leap is up; walk her to a wall, wait it out, then E-stun and drop a full-Grit Haymaker.

edits.before: From level 2 you take over: Q slow into E Facebreaker stun catches the squishy mage, and a Grit-charged W chunks her hard. Walk her down whenever her W blink is down.
edits.after: From level 2 you take over: Q slow into E Facebreaker catches the squishy mage, and a Grit-charged Haymaker chunks her. Walk her down whenever Across the Veil is spent.

edits.before: By 2+ items Aurora flips it back -- her poke, W blink, and R zoning kite your engage from range. Build MR, hold E for after her blink, and never fight without your stun ready.
edits.after: By 2+ items her poke, Across the Veil, and the Between Worlds rift kite your engage from range. Build MR, hold E for after the leap, and never fight without your stun ready.

edits.before: Suppress her through the W blink with your R
edits.after: Use R before she leaps, not after her escape

edits.before: Blink away from your combo with W Twofold Hex
edits.after: Leap out of your combo on Across the Veil

notes: Two separate fabrications here. First, the entry tracked an ability called 'Twofold Hex (Blink)' — it fused her Q (a 9s curse missile) with her W leap and used the fused name in twelve places. Second, it twice told the reader to spend a 120-second ultimate suppressing her through a blink; The Show Stopper has no suppression in Riot's text and the mirror audit removed the identical claim. I followed the mirror's chart (Aurora / Skill / Sett / Sett / Aurora / Sett / Skill) rather than the packet chart, which differs at Level 6 and 2+ items.
